detail.title: AI Dependency in Athlete Training
detail.question: How does reliance on AI-driven training recommendations affect athlete autonomy and self-regulation?
detail.reason: Preliminary evidence establishes a link between AI reliance and reduced self-regulation, warranting further investigation into how this preferences emerges in athletes.
